name: Telegram AI image bot with Nano Banana Pro (MegaBrain)
description: Telegram bot that turns any message into a 2K Nano Banana Pro image via the MegaBrain API, with a friendly reply when generation fails.

name: Generate AI videos with Kling 3 from a form (MegaBrain)
description: A form that turns a one-line idea into a Kling 3 video: a free LLM writes the prompt, the MegaBrain queue renders the clip, and a wait/poll loop returns the video URL.

name: Instagram carousel images and caption with FLUX 2 (MegaBrain)
description: Plans an Instagram carousel with a free LLM, draws each slide with FLUX 2 at 1080×1350 through the MegaBrain API, and returns the slide URLs with a ready caption.

name: Product photo to video ad with Nano Banana Pro and Kling 3 (MegaBrain)
description: UGC-style ad from one product photo: a free LLM writes the scene, Nano Banana Pro Edit makes a lifestyle shot that keeps the label, and Kling 3 animates it into a vertical clip.

name: AI agent on 100+ models with one key (MegaBrain, OpenAI-compatible)
description: A chat AI agent whose OpenAI Chat Model node points at MegaBrain: one key for Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM and more, and a free model to start.
